## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Agatha Sowerby notices [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) dressed up and leaving town in a buggy on a busy afternoon, sparking her curiosity. Later that evening, she visits [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to discover the reason for his trip. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) explains that [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) has gone to the train station to pick up an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on their farm, leading [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to express her strong doubts and warnings.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) brings the newly orphaned twins, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), back to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) proves to be extremely energetic and prone to mischief, including dropping a caterpillar down Lauretta's dress during church. During a meeting of the [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) at the house, a dripping-wet [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) bursts into the dining room after [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) entices her outside.
>
> — v2 · VIII Thirza Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) Sowerby's death, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposes inviting the widowed [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) can attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigns from her teaching position, causing her students great dismay, while she and Isolde discuss the upcoming changes in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).
>
